g.text: Marine curves: Barnet et al. (2019) Atlantic Site 1262 and its Pacific Site 1209 comparison. Top marine axis uses the Barnet published Site 1262 BWT-d18O relation (T = 10.37 - 4.44 x d18O). Terrestrial T47 age
bars show an assumed +/-0.2 Myr plotting uncertainty; formal age uncertainty is not propagated. Pink band marks the PETM.
Marine and continental temperature records, 59-52.5 Ma
